title: Ghosted's Better Granite
description: "Just Better Granite" Makes granite and polished granite have more subtle textures.
body:
# Better Granite
Better Granite is a very simple pack that changes the textures of granite and polished graniite to be a little more subtle.


<details>
<summary>Granite</summary>

![New Granite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6ff0da321b1ce504e3fcdeb68cabd215804dc94.png)

</details>

# Important
- This pack can be used in any and all modpacks
- Pack may say made for an older or newer version of minecraft but it should still work fine
